title: Chapter 359 Deserted City Reveals Strength
content:
Chapter 359 Deserted City Reveals Strength

However, as soon as he finished speaking, Lu Xue suddenly trembled all over, and then a traction from her blood suddenly penetrated her whole body.

Lu Xue looked surprised.

"It's dad!"

At this time, outside the hall, a woman in plain clothes slowly walked out of the hall.

At this moment, the woman also had a bright smile on her face, and her eyes were filled with tenderness.

"Mom, there is news from dad!"

Seeing the woman walking towards her, Lu Xue's smile became even worse.

"Your father may need your help now." Yan Lingyun chuckled as she looked at Lu Xue.

Need your own help.

This sentence suddenly echoed in Lu Xue's heart, and a feeling of excitement was beyond words.

I have been practicing so hard over the years and doing everything around me hard, isn’t it just to make my father proud?

At this moment, when Lu Xue heard that her father needed his help, she was immediately infinitely satisfied.

At the same time, a terrifying strange phenomenon came from the void.

The chaotic aura that covered the sky and the sun covered the entire desert city. For a moment, the aura in the desert city became extremely depressing. Countless people from the desert city were surprised by their cultivation and quickly flew out of their mansion, staring at the void with a cautious expression.

Outside the deserted city, the powerful people on the other side of the starry sky also put down their affairs and rushed towards the deserted city.

After so many years of development, although Huangcheng has rarely made any moves, Huangcheng is still the overlord of the starry sky and even all known worlds.

They will always be vassals of the deserted city.

At this moment, they were shocked and shocked. The deserted city was hailed as a forbidden city, transcending everything. Even the forces of order dared not offend it, but at this moment, someone actually reached out to the deserted city.

Then what exactly will exist?

"The way of heaven?"

A strong questioning voice sounded from the depths of the deserted city.

The next moment, a slightly oppressive aura suddenly appeared from the sky.

"It's unfair, it's not me!"

The way of heaven wants to cry without tears.

If you have this ability, you won’t be like this.

Seeing this, everyone frowned even deeper.

It’s not the way of heaven, is it?

At this time, several powerful auras appeared.

Several masters of the Great Order Hall descended outside the deserted city.

"Everyone, this matter is definitely not done by our Order Hall."

The Lord of the Time and Space Palace, Shikongying, bowed to the deserted city, and said with a solemn expression.

There was a moment of silence in the deserted city.

Suddenly, the void trembled, and several terrifying figures flew out of the deserted city and soared into the sky.

Several of the Order Hall’s owners had their eyelids twitched wildly.

The other powerful people who came here were sweating coldly and sucking in cold air.

This is the first time in countless years that Huangcheng has shown its strength.

Leading by Awei, Gu Chen and An Xing, the other core figures in the deserted city were exposed to the world.

His aura actually reached the terrifying ninth level of the disaster realm!

(Immortal Emperor Realm Entering the Tao, Palm Dao Breaking the Tao, Origin Realm Origin Realm No Border Return Realm One to Nine Order Realm)

So many powerful people in the Tribulation Realm are so terrifying.

You must know that the masters of the Order Hall are just robbing.

How do these strong men in Huangcheng practice? They are simply not human.

But at this moment, facing the horror of the world, the people in Huangcheng were indifferent, but looked up at the void with a cautious expression.

The pressure pointed directly at their deserted city.

Is this a provocation?

Which force did it? Is there really a world in the world that they have not discovered?

Everyone was confused.

And at this time, another breath appeared in the field.

As soon as this aura appeared, all the strong auras fell down halfway.

"Sir, Lord!"

The powerful men in the Order Hall looked happy and hurried forward.

The person who comes is the Master Yuanji.

The strongest person in the known world.

Everyone in Huangcheng also looked at the Yuanji Venerable, and there was a trace of fear in their eyes.

A strong man in the order realm.

If the city lord is not here, they are really no match.

Just when Awei's expression was slightly dark, the space beside him suddenly cracked.

The next moment, a man with a strange aura slowly walked out of the crack in the space.

I saw that the man was surrounded by an indescribable black substance. No matter where the man went, these black substances followed closely.

Awei and the other two were closest, and their expressions were extremely surprising.

It’s just because this man’s realm is actually a realm of order.

Although it is not as stable as the aura of the Yuanji Venerable, it is also a true strongman in the Order Realm.

"Chuo, you?!"

A Wei was so rare that he didn't control his expression and said in extreme surprise.

Hearing this, Kong was expressionless.

"Just lucky."

......

"I actually rely on this method to reach the state of order. I am worthy of being the person around me."

Master Yuanji also looked at him and praised him without hesitation.

The state of order.

After what Master Yuanji said, everyone present was completely exploded.

In addition to Venerable Yuanji, a second strong man in the Order Realm appeared on the surface!

For a moment, the status of the deserted city, which was already extremely terrifying in their hearts, was once again raised.

Although they knew that the Lord of the Huangcheng City was no longer here, these strong people in the Huangcheng City were never ignored.

What's more, there is also the wife and daughter of the Lord of the Huangcheng City.

The strength of those two people is still a mystery.

"alright."

At this time, Awei, who had the highest status in the field, spoke.

For a moment, the restless atmosphere in the field became quiet instantly.

As the earliest existence to follow the city lord, even though Ah Wei is not the strongest, he is definitely the most respected existence.

His words are naturally very intimidating.

"Honor Yuanji, I wonder what your opinion is about this?"

Awei looked at the Yuanji Venerable in the distance and spoke calmly.

Hearing this, the expression of Venerable Yuanji became solemn. He looked up at the mysterious fluctuation pointing directly to the deserted city in the void, and said slightly heavier: "I guess that this is very likely to be a legendary higher-dimensional world. of."

While speaking, Venerable Yuanji's eyes were still slightly excited and ecstasy.

A higher-dimensional world is the goal he has sought for most of his life.

Now, he finally saw a little hope.

"A world of higher dimensions?!"

However, before everyone could react, the fluctuations coming from the void expanded again. The next moment, a straight beam of light rushed straight towards the deserted city below.

City Lord’s Mansion!

"presumptuous!"

Seeing this, the strong men in the Huangcheng City suddenly had their eyes scattered, and they dared to attack the city lord's mansion in front of them.

Boom boom boom boom!

Several terrifying forces were shot out from the hands of the powerful people in the deserted city, and their voices were shocking!

Buzz —

At this time, a slender figure suddenly blocked the beam of light that spread the attacks of everyone with a casual blow.

"Everything comes back."

An unquestionable voice came from the mouth of the figure.

Everyone was shocked.

It was the city lord’s wife!
